SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Living Together Suggested vocabulary share, respect, together, love, care, livin in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How would you know if someone is listening to you? 2. How do we learn to pronounce words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: A learner self-discipline is enhanced as they collaboratively practise using vocabulary learnt to express their own ideas.

Values:
Respect: patience is enhanced as the learner accepts diverse opinions from others in group activities.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship (social cohesion) is enhanced as the learner practices living together in harmony.

Link to other Learning Areas

Attentive listening and knowledge of vocabulary will help learners in all learning areas.

Suggested learning resources

• Textbooks in print and in braille

• Audio recording

• Digital devices with assistive technology
